name: Hatch Green Chile Chicken Casserole
note: Crustless hatch-green-chile chicken bake over a zucchini + bell-pepper body, bound with heavy cream + cream cheese + pepper-jack; no rice/tortilla/bean base. Cross-lane checked against fresh accepted-slugs.json. Shares the cream-cheese-bound baked-chicken frame with accepted jalapeno-popper-chicken-casserole, but distinguished on TWO axes - different vegetable base (zucchini+bell-pepper vs cauliflower/none) and different flavor family (roasted hatch green chile, Southwestern, vs jalapeno-popper bacon) - so a genuinely different dinner. Kept where I rejected buffalo-chicken-cauliflower-casserole in this same batch precisely because hatch is more distinct: buffalo shared cauliflower+creamy-cheese-bacon with the accepted ranch bake (only sauce differed), whereas hatch changes base AND cuisine and widens an open baked-green-chile niche the catalog (bowls/burritos only) lacks. Chicken is the heaviest lane, so this is the last creamy-chicken-bake I'd take this run absent a strong cuisine reason. Cross-protein note (not resolved): a green-chile turkey/pork casserole would be the same bake minus protein - future-lane merge concern only.
